concerns.text: T031 restricts sensitivity analysis to k in {1, 3, 5}, but Spec Assumptions explicitly define the scope as k in {1, 3, 5, 10}. This is a silent scope reduction (weakening) of the experimental design defined in the spec, violating the requirement to measure sensitivity against the full set of defined k values.

T027 describes a 'loop to execute multiple runs' but fails to explicitly enforce the N >= 5 constraint mandated by FR-008. Without this explicit constraint in the task description, the deliverable risks falling short of the statistical power requirement defined in the spec.

T035b instructs to 'Switch to FAISS' to meet latency targets without first establishing a baseline measurement. This introduces a silent architectural change (optimization) before verifying the current implementation's performance, violating the principle of measuring against the target (SC-003) before altering the solution.
